summary: Adds the 'after a duel resolves' Reaction trigger (own-won-duel, issue #209): a duel is a single, complete action from challenge to consequences, and once it fully resolves the winning card's own controller gets a chance to react, the same shape own-enters-play already uses for entering-play Reactions. Wires Personality Wave 10 (3 real cards): Kitsuki Daisuke-exp (draw), Kitsuki Horume (gain 1 Honor -- flavor text dropped, confirmed with the user), and Kitsuki Jakuei (take the Imperial Favor, plus a separate Political Battle ability discarding the Favor to move a bowed target home bowed). Lane is 'shared' only because the packaging script's own generated card-artwork copies land under src/L5R.Client/Content/Published/, the established convention -- no client UI code itself changes.
validation: dotnet build src/L5R.Core/L5R.Core.csproj: 0 errors. dotnet run --project tests/L5R.Core.Tests: 128/128 core (including a new DuelWonReaction test) + 34/34 published + 8/8 deck-format all passing. python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/content: 121/121. python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/collaboration: 43/43. docs/ROADMAP.md and docs/CARD_INVENTORY.xlsx (244 wired) regenerated.
remaining: Kitsuki Horume's own first ability (an entering-play Reaction) remains blocked on a not-yet-built 'choose a player' targeting primitive. Mirumoto Yozo, Experienced 2 remains blocked on a broader 'after an Iaijutsu action resolves' generalization (any Iaijutsu action, not just a duel).
